payload.campaign: uuid — the campaign whose live session's player view shows the window
payload.w: number — the width of the box the dragged corner draws, a fraction of the screen's width
payload.h: number, optional — the height of that box, a fraction of the screen's width too: a hint. The width stored is the largest the box holds at the illustration's ratio (fit): min(w, h × width_px / height_px), brought between 0.1 and 1, the screen's width; with no h, it is w (width-led). The height is never stored: it is window_width × height_px / width_px (window-proportional). The position and the media stay; a window that is not open is rejected under window-fields-together
